hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty)'); root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */.worktrees/*|*/OVERSEER.md|*/.claude/*|*/CLAUDE.md|*/docs/*) exit 0;; esac; if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -z "${OVERSEER_GUARD_OFF:-}" ]; then jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg r "$root" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Blocked by the overseer-kit worktree guard: " + $f + " is inside the primary checkout " + $r + ", not inside a .worktrees/ checkout. Set up a worktree first: git -C " + $r + " fetch origin main --quiet && git -C " + $r + " worktree add -b <branch> <worktree-root>/<slug> origin/main, then redo this edit inside it. OVERSEER.md, .claude/, CLAUDE.md and docs/ are exempt (prose). Set OVERSEER_GUARD_OFF=1 for a task you are driving live in the main checkout.")}}'; fi
